reason: A client that stays connected must get partial chunks and the full answer; the event minimum is the floor for a tool-using turn.
Consecutive /run_sse and /run requests must each be answered correctly.
After a dropped SSE client the session must stay readable and the server must serve a new session, with the user message guaranteeing the text match.
A session used via /run then /run_sse must keep its history so the second answer builds on the first.
